note: OpenCode Go /responses with the custom tool for gpt-6-luna: the live key has EXPIRED (401 api_key_expired); the freeform question is unanswered.

content.text: Create the file /tmp/x/hello.txt containing the single line `hello` using the apply_patch tool. Call the tool now; do not explain.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Use the `apply_patch` tool to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.

format.definition:
start: begin_patch hunk+ end_patch
begin_patch: "*** Begin Patch" LF
end_patch: "*** End Patch" LF?

hunk: add_hunk | delete_hunk | update_hunk
add_hunk: "*** Add File: " filename LF add_line+
delete_hunk: "*** Delete File: " filename LF
update_hunk: "*** Update File: " filename LF change_move? change?

filename: /(.+)/
add_line: "+" /(.*)/ LF -> line

change_move: "*** Move to: " filename LF
change: (change_context | change_line)+ eof_line?
change_context: ("@@" | "@@ " /(.+)/) LF
change_line: ("+" | "-" | " ") /(.*)/ LF
eof_line: "*** End of File" LF

%import common.LF

body: {"error":{"type":"authentication_error","code":"api_key_expired","message":"This API key has expired. Create a new API key in OpenCode Console and replace it in your client or secret store. Signing in again will not renew this key."}}
